g.text: D2/D3 clamp the buffer input to the rails. Low-leakage diodes: leakage x 10M sets the offset budget (check datasheet).

g.desc: D2/D3 clamp the buffer input to the rails. Low-leakage diodes: leakage x 10M sets the offset budget (check datasheet).

g.text: PVDF film (~1.4 nF class) with 10M bias: high-pass ~11 Hz. R42 limits clamp current during heel-strike spikes.

g.desc: PVDF film (~1.4 nF class) with 10M bias: high-pass ~11 Hz. R42 limits clamp current during heel-strike spikes.

g.text: ~1.3-1.7 mA per emitter at 3.3 V. Red + green together is read as amber.

g.desc: ~1.3-1.7 mA per emitter at 3.3 V. Red + green together is read as amber.

g.text: Light-window brightness and colour separation must be checked in the printed cover.
